name.ja: HG 1/72 ブレイディハウンド

description.ja: 2021年10月より放送開始の『境界戦機』から、海老川兼武氏デザインの北米同盟軍量産機ブレイディハウンドが早くもHGにラインアップ！
description.en: From "Kyoukai Senki" which started broadcasting from 202110, the North American Alliance Army mass-produced machine Brady Hound designed by Kanetake Ebikawa is already available in the HG lineup!

description.ja: ■専用ナイフが２本付属、専用ライフルはマガジンとグレネードが着脱可能。
description.en: • Two special knives are included, and the special rifle has a detachable magazine and grenade.

description.ja: ■ハンドパーツは２種付属。武器持ち手は手甲パーツをスライドしナックルモードを再現。
description.en: • Two types of hand parts are included. The weapon holder can be recreated in knuckle mode by sliding the gauntlet parts.

description.ja: ■駐機状態用の頭部パーツも付属し、差し替えで再現可能。
description.en: • A head part for the parked state is also included and can be reproduced by replacing it.

description.ja: ■「HG 1/72 V-33 ストークキャリー」(別売り)と組み合わせて輸送状態を再現。
description.en: • Reproduce the transportation condition in combination with "HG 1/72 V-33 Stalk Carry" (sold separately).

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ 武器持ち手(左右)、平手(左右)
accessories.en: Hand parts Weapon handle (left and right), open hand (left and right)

accessories.ja: 専用ライフル(グレネードランチャー装備)×1
accessories.en: Special rifle (equipped with grenade launcher) x 1
